entries.title: Keep apply and build stages off dirty repositories
when: Tracked edits already exist before apply starts.
The repo cleanliness check blocks the operation.
do: Clean or isolate the worktree before rebuilding.
Preserve the current task artifacts and stop early.
avoid: Applying a new patch on top of unreviewed tracked edits.
